        {"name":"Anthony", "location":"Pacific Heights", "start":hm(14,15), "end":hm(16,0), "min":30},
    ]

    # Starting point

    start_time = hm(9,0)

    # Helper: map name to person
    by_name = {p["name"]: dict(p) for p in people}

    # Order candidates by earliest end time, then start
    order = sorted([p["name"] for p in people], key=lambda n: (by_name[n]["end"], by_name[n]["start"]))

    best = {
        "count": 0,
        "total_meet": 0,
        "total_travel": float("inf"),
        "end_time": start_time,
        "itinerary": []
    }

    # DFS search
    def dfs(curr_loc, curr_time, remaining_names, itinerary, total_travel, total_meet):
        nonlocal best

        curr_count = len(itinerary)
        # Update best
        better = False
        if curr_count > best["count"]:
            better = True
        elif curr_count == best["count"]:
            if total_meet > best["total_meet"]:
                better = True
            elif total_meet == best["total_meet"]:
                if total_travel < best["total_travel"]:
                    better = True
                elif total_travel == best["total_travel"]:
                    if curr_time < best["end_time"]:
                        better = True
        if better:
            best = {
                "count": curr_count,
                "total_meet": total_meet,
                "total_travel": total_travel,
                "end_time": curr_time,
                "itinerary": list(itinerary)
            }

        # Upper bound prune (can't beat best by count)
        if curr_count + len(remaining_names) <= best["count"]:
            return

        # Try each remaining person by order
        for name in order:
            if name not in remaining_names:
                continue
            p = by_name[name]
            # Travel to person
            travel_time = t.get((curr_loc, p["location"]))
            if travel_time is None:
                continue  # if missing, skip
            arrival = curr_time + travel_time
            latest_start = p["end"] - p["min"]
            if arrival > latest_start:
                continue  # cannot make minimum duration
            start = max(arrival, p["start"])
            end = start + p["min"]
            if end > p["end"]:
                continue

            new_remaining = tuple(n for n in remaining_names if n != name)
            new_meet = {
                "action": "meet",
                "location": p["location"],
                "person": p["name"],
                "start_time": start,
                "end_time": end
            }
            itinerary.append(new_meet)
            dfs(p["location"], end, new_remaining, itinerary, total_travel + travel_time, total_meet + p["min"])
            itinerary.pop()

    remaining_all = tuple(p["name"] for p in people)
    dfs(start_location, start_time, remaining_all, [], 0, 0)

    # Build JSON output with formatted times
    output = {"itinerary": []}
    for m in best["itinerary"]:
        output["itinerary"].append({
            "action": "meet",
            "location": m["location"],
            "person": m["person"],
            "start_time": minutes_to_time_str(m["start_time"]),
            "end_time": minutes_to_time_str(m["end_time"])
        })

    print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False))
